title: Phân hệ 5: Điều hướng Robot & Bản đồ SLAM (Physical ERD)
code:
erDiagram
    MAP {
        int MapID PK
        int FloorID FK
        varchar MapName
        text MapData
        varchar FloorplanImageUrl
        float WidthMeters
        float HeightMeters
        float Resolution
        float OriginX
        float OriginY
        float OriginYaw
        bit IsActive
        datetime CreatedAt
        varchar SlamDataUrl
        varchar PosegraphUrl
        text RawYamlContent
    }
    NAVIGATION_NODE {
        int NodeID PK
        int MapID FK
        varchar NodeName
        float XCoord
        float YCoord
        varchar NodeType
        varchar NodeRole
        bit IsBlocked
        float HeadingYaw
    }
    NAVIGATION_EDGE {
        int EdgeID PK
        int FromNodeID FK
        int ToNodeID FK
        float Distance
        bit IsBidirectional
    }
    ROBOT {
        int RobotID PK
        varchar RobotName
        varchar RobotCode
        int BatteryPct
        varchar Mode
        varchar Status
        datetime LastSeenAt
        varchar IPAddress
    }
    ROBOT_LOG {
        int LogID PK
        int RobotID FK
        int battery
        varchar location
        varchar status
        datetime timestamp
        float XCoord
        float YCoord
        float HeadingRad
        int CurrentNodeId
    }
    SHELF_SCAN {
        int ScanID PK
        int ShelfID FK
        int RobotID FK
        int NavigationNodeID FK
        varchar MissionID
        int WaypointIndex
        datetime ScannedAt
        decimal EmptyPercentage
        decimal DensityPercentage
        bit NeedsRestock
        varchar ImageUrl
        int EmptySlotCount
        text AiRecommendation
        text AiRawJson
        varchar AnalysisStatus
    }
    SEMANTIC_OBJECT {
        int ObjectID PK
        int MapID FK
        varchar ObjectType
        float XMin
        float YMin
        float XMax
        float YMax
        varchar Label
        float Confidence
        datetime DetectedAt
        varchar ImageUrl
        int ProductTypeID FK
    }

    MAP ||--o{ NAVIGATION_NODE : ""
    NAVIGATION_NODE ||--o{ NAVIGATION_EDGE : ""
    NAVIGATION_NODE ||--o{ SHELF_SCAN : ""
    MAP ||--o{ SEMANTIC_OBJECT : ""
    ROBOT ||--o{ ROBOT_LOG : ""
    ROBOT ||--o{ SHELF_SCAN : ""
